reconstruction.identityBasis: Retained Q125445 way/24824550 is the whole Temple of Heaven park boundary. It is preserved as evidence, never extruded. Current standard PMTiles identifies Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests as building/POI35184416009971 (OSM way43921139), with a19-vertex circular footprint and height38m. reconstruction.heightBasis: The mapped main hall height38m sets the approximate overall top above its local grade; its datum is unspecified. Its mapped diameter is about28.64m. Three roof overhangs, wall/drum heights, finial, balcony bands, stairs and marble terrace radii are picture-guided estimates. Standard path/steps vertices about50m from the hall center support the outer terrace extent. No survey, exact artwork, structural joints or historic inscriptions are claimed. Imperial Vault retains the mapped19.02m overall height above its chosen court floor;its round map extent constrains the eave radius. Roof/body divisions,platform and annex heights remain picture-guided estimates. Three1.7m rises,rail heights,gate heights,blue coping and stair profiles are picture-guided exterior estimates. No mapped altitude or surveyed dimensions are claimed for the altar. Ground seating is median16 retained standard DEM samples around32m radius plus0.15m. All palace heights are picture-guided estimates:main hall raised0.9m with walls to7.4m and green roof ridge12.5m;east gate wall7m/roof11.8m;ancillary roofs4.8–6.6m. No mapped height or surveyed threshold is claimed. Court grade is the median16 retained standard DEM building-center samples plus0.15m;moat surface is0.65m below that floor. Heights are picture-guided visualization estimates,not survey values:music main/rear walls5.8m,roofs10.4/9.6m;entry4.7/8m;attached ranges3.8/6m;principal kitchen halls4.9/8m;other halls3.5/5.8m;hexagonal pavilion roofs7.2m. Roof envelopes follow each mapped axis and footprint extent;small protrusions retain wall outlines but share simplified roof envelopes. Bay counts and roof/gate details are approximate. Picture-guided estimates:Long Corridor deck follows retained DEM+0.25m,eaves about4m above deck,ridge5.7m;red columns repeat about4m close up. Longevity lower eave3.9m,upper eave5.4m,roof7.3m and two finials8.2m. Gate walls5.7m/roof8.5m,small Sixty-Year gate3.5/5.4m,red walls3.2m plus blue coping. Gate arch forms,roof types and colors are visualization estimates,not individually verified architectural measurements.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Approximate site fit from retained standard viewer PMTiles and DEM plus ordinary exterior pictures. Native+X is east,+Z south;fixed heading0 and the main hall footprint center define the pose. NativeY0 is the original DEM sample at that anchor,not a surveyed floor. Thirteen separately covered ground pockets preserve the park between groups. The building-only mask preserves independent mapped buildings,including attached shared edges. Host terrain data must resolve the same reference coordinate;architectural floor grades,gate forms,wall routes and exact facing remain visualization estimates. The source-local lowered review terrain remains an approximate fixture. Final site review also uses the original unmodified standard DEM with13separate covered ground pockets,partitioned access paths,and preserved independent map buildings. Host DEM differences can alter edge seating;physical device and full-city measurements remain pending.
reconstruction.scope: Temple of Heaven principal exterior site:Hall of Prayer,northern halls,Imperial Vault,Circular Mound Altar,Palace of Abstinence,music/service groups,Long Corridor,Longevity Pavilion,selected precinct gates/walls and processional paving. Geographic integration is an explicitly approximate reconstruction from standard viewer data;fine ground ornaments,interiors and unverified southern wall links are omitted.

north.basis: Current standard PMTiles identifies the northern Imperial Hall of Heaven building/POI35184416009972 (OSMway43921140) and neighboring gate35184416009973. Four-vertex footprints and their slight relative offset are retained; the hall long edge supplies its local east-west axis. Missing height tags, roof shapes, raised platform, three individual portal subdivisions, court and low perimeter walls are picture-guided estimates. No courtyard wall survey, fine inscriptions, exact threshold or navigable hall interior is claimed.

terrainSeating.method: Median of64 standard-DEM samples at54m radius plus0.15m; translates the main architecture without rescaling. Coarse DEM under the hall is elevated relative to its perimeter.
terrainSeating.northMethod: Median of7 courtyard standard-DEM samples plus0.20m.

echoWall.basis: The wall is not independently present in the retained vector layers. Its circle is fitted to ten vertices of the adjacent western pedestrian-paving arc,then offset inward2.4m by visual estimate. The mapped vault,annex and southern-gate footprints constrain the enclosure arrangement. Wall height/thickness,offset and blue coping are picture-guided estimates;this is approximate visualization fit,not surveyed wall geometry.

vault.gradeBasis: Median of16 standard retained DEM courtyard samples at27m radius plus0.15m. No separate terrain source or survey.
vault.identityBasis: Imperial Vault building/POI35184416009953 has a19-vertex circular map outline and height19.02m. Named East/West Annex Hall controls35184416009949/35184416009954 retain their individual four-vertex outlines and local facade axes. Mapped southern enclosure gate35184416009955 supplies its center and width. Fine roof profiles,platforms,steps,arch shapes and painted decoration are picture-guided estimates.
vault.scope: Imperial Vault exterior with a single swept blue-gray roof and golden finial,red timber front bays and gray masonry rear;one raised marble base and front steps;two individually mapped inward-facing annex halls;hollow Echo Wall with blue coping and an open three-arch southern gate. No copied art,inscriptions or navigable hall interior.

altar.identityBasis: Upper and middle terraces retain separate PMTiles building-part outlines35184609785410/35184609785411. Their19 vertices define mean radii;the otherwise unmapped bottom radius extrapolates the same radial interval. Two named altar POIs are identity points,not an additional building. Four inner Lingxing and four outer precinct gates retain independent mapped centers and widths. The inner circle and outer square are approximate connections between those controls,not separately mapped walls.
altar.heightBasis: Three1.7m rises,rail heights,gate heights,blue coping and stair profiles are picture-guided exterior estimates. No mapped altitude or surveyed dimensions are claimed for the altar. Ground seating is median16 retained standard DEM samples around32m radius plus0.15m.
altar.scope: Three circular marble terraces,four radial flights per tier,sparse open stone rails,central round paving stone,eight stone Lingxing portal groups,and hollow red circular/square enclosures with blue coping. Coarse original gate ornaments;fine relief and inscriptions omitted. Portal center leaves are shown closed with side passages open as in the inspected picture.

palace.identityBasis: Palace of Abstinence POI35185672993917 supplies precinct identity. Eighteen independent mapped buildings lie within the outer moat;main hall35184416013921,east gate35184416013916 and inner gate35184416013917 retain their own outlines and axes. Three nearby external records are excluded. Main-hall/gate roles are inferred from the map layout and the two named exterior pictures;unlabelled ancillary identities remain provisional. All six-vertex outlines are retained;rectangular roof envelopes are explicit approximations.
palace.waterBasis: Retained water3132850 has two overlapping tile fragments and five polygon pieces. The outer moat uses four outside and four island corners selected from those exact vertices. The complete eastern C-shaped inner moat is used once;duplicate clipped pieces are not drawn. No diagonal join between disconnected polygons and no filled courtyard lake.
palace.heightBasis: All palace heights are picture-guided estimates:main hall raised0.9m with walls to7.4m and green roof ridge12.5m;east gate wall7m/roof11.8m;ancillary roofs4.8–6.6m. No mapped height or surveyed threshold is claimed. Court grade is the median16 retained standard DEM building-center samples plus0.15m;moat surface is0.65m below that floor.
palace.scope: Red masonry main hall with five recessed bays,blue frieze and green swept roof;four mapped gate buildings;three raised bridge decks at each east/inner gate;13 mapped ancillary halls;gray enclosure,outer ring moat and inner C-shaped moat. Details and unlabelled identities are approximate.

services.identityBasis: Retained Divine Music Administration POI35185075701628 associates the courtyard-ring record52776574884553 with three separate hall footprints. Central hall35184850023561 is provisionally Ningxi Hall,western35185598729740 Xianyou Hall,eastern35185598729739 the entry hall,using mapped axial order and ordinary pictures. Ring geometry is four connected roofed ranges around its retained courtyard hole,not a solid box. North/south Divine Kitchen and sacrificial-pavilion POIs identify the eastern service groups. All twenty independent building footprints and the music ring remain individually recorded;small unlabelled identities are provisional.
services.heightBasis: Heights are picture-guided visualization estimates,not survey values:music main/rear walls5.8m,roofs10.4/9.6m;entry4.7/8m;attached ranges3.8/6m;principal kitchen halls4.9/8m;other halls3.5/5.8m;hexagonal pavilion roofs7.2m. services.terrainBasis: Each service cluster uses the median retained standard DEM height at its building centers plus0.15m. Preview terrain seating uses the retained source grid with an explicit20m interpolation margin;host terrain replacement and full precinct fit remain pending.
services.scope: Music main and rear halls have red timber bays,gray swept hip-and-gable roofs with gold ridge accents;four roofed enclosure ranges preserve the central courtyard hole. Separate north/south kitchen and service halls use red wood,blue friezes and green roofs,with two six-sided pavilion roofs and simplified columns. No copied glyphs,relief,decorative artwork,displays or navigable interiors.

buildingMask.basis: Explicit occupancy mask for the authored68 mapped buildings and their courts. A single simple building-only polygon connects separate components with narrow strips;these are mask topology,not physical structures or terrain openings. A3cm outside edge allowance avoids numerical procedural slivers after world-coordinate transforms. All784 independent retained map buildings are subtracted from this mask and remain unchanged. Two quantized shared-edge slivers,totaling0.1802m²,are retained for their attached independent neighbors. The whole-park boundary is never used.
